why: phase-499 W4 (RFC-0089 amendment 2026-10-13) -- serves the node's parameters on the six rcl_interfaces/srv/* services. rclcpp starts them from NodeOptions::start_parameter_services(true); that option is REFUSED here (NodeOptions carries no runtime state, see options.hpp), so a node calls this instead of the nros_cpp_register_parameter_services FFI a user used to reach for. Ours-only under rclcpp:: by the 2026-09-05 rule; no upstream Node method of that name exists to collide with.
